feature: SPEC-016 M2 bounded Git partial-order experiment
conflictsOfInterest: The founder is the project maintainer. This internal review is not independent external validation.
decisionText: **Veredicto: favorable, con alcance acotado.** Apruebo SPEC-016 como experimento privado de M2. La relación de independencia se mantiene sintáctica y conservadora; el fixture de Git real aporta evidencia concreta para el reductor de SPEC-015; y los límites científicos están expresados con claridad. Antes de considerar esta aprobación suficiente para fusionar, solicito dos ajustes: (1) aclarar que el oráculo se vuelve a generar y el verificador existente lo reproduce; no son implementaciones independientes del motor de replay; (2) añadir una prueba directa que confirme que una operación con `uncertainPaths` no se considera intercambiable. Esta aprobación cubre el experimento finito y privado. No avala una mejora de rendimiento en producción, conmutatividad semántica, confluencia general ni autorización de ejecución.
conditionsResolved: SPEC-016 now states that the existing verifier regenerates and checks the exhaustive baseline using the same replay implementation; no independent replay engine is claimed.
A real-Git test supplies uncertainPaths on a disjoint-path operation and confirms both admissible orders remain selected with no independent pair.
scope: Private finite partial-order reduction experiment for fixed Git commit patches, its replay-verified exhaustive baseline, and the tested uncertain-path control.
rationale: The focused suite passed 24 tests. Quick and PR validation each passed 241 tests with one expected skip; Spec Kit validation, scientific controls, contract checks and render checks passed. The approval applies only to the bounded experiment and its stated observations.
limits: The verifier repeats the exhaustive replay using the same replay implementation; this is not independent implementation diversity.
The finite path relation does not prove semantic commutation, arbitrary-workload confluence or production speedup.
No execution, integration, ref-promotion or M2-closure authority is granted.
Clean-room reproduction and independent external validation remain pending.
